output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    # locate the four equal-colored corner markers (the color occurring four times)
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row if x)
    marker=next((c for c,n in cnt.items() if n==4), 9)
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,x in enumerate(row) if x==marker]
    rs=sorted(set(r for r,c in pts)); cs=sorted(set(c for r,c in pts))
    r0,r1=rs[0],rs[-1]; c0,c1=cs[0],cs[-1]
    return [[marker if grid[r][c] else 0 for c in range(c0+1,c1)] for r in range(r0+1,r1)]"}

output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row if x)
    marker=next((c for c,n in cnt.items() if n==4), 9)
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,x in enumerate(row) if x==marker]
    rs=sorted(set(r for r,c in pts)); cs=sorted(set(c for r,c in pts))
    if len(rs)<2 or len(cs)<2: return [[0,marker]]
    return [[marker if grid[r][c] else 0 for c in range(cs[0]+1,cs[-1])] for r in range(rs[0]+1,rs[-1])]"}
